findings.title: Commit points are checkbox task items instead of plain-line `**Commit**:` markers
findings.description: The commit points are written as checklist tasks — `- [ ] **Task 2C: Commit** — ...` (lines 71, 94, 117, 126, 134). The marker convention requires commit markers to be plain lines, never checkboxes, so they are not consumed as completable work items. Placement is correct — 2C/3C/4C sit at working, tested points after each implementation+test pair, and 5C/6C are correctly conditional — and the semantic commit messages follow the git rules, so this is a form fix only: render the five entries as plain `**Commit**: \`feat(...)\`` lines rather than checkbox "Task XC" items.
